name: codex-auto-router
description: Classify coding tasks in ChatGPT and dispatch them to a connected local Codex CLI using the cheapest sufficient tier.

interface.shortDescription: Route ChatGPT coding tasks to local Codex with a quota-conscious tier.
interface.longDescription: ChatGPT classifies task complexity and, when the local MCP bridge is connected, starts the task directly in the local Codex CLI without spending a separate Codex turn on classification.
defaultPrompt: Route this coding task to the cheapest sufficient Codex tier and start it locally.
Hand this bug fix to my local Codex using an efficient tier.
Start this task in Codex without wasting quota on classification.
